cases.title: 短码输入保真、格式错误提示及合成账号登录
cases.historical_observation: JT reported both short-code forms failed; exact original input/build/request and first cause remain UNKNOWN. Do not infer configuration loss or quota exhaustion.
cases.known_contract: Case-sensitive G2C@<two ASCII digits> or CJ_Tester@<two ASCII digits>, 01 through 99; no surrounding whitespace, full-width digits or spelling substitution
preconditions: A provides a verified isolated ordinary Beta installation; do not sign JT out or read/clear the JT journal.
B supplies an existing approved C synthetic account/private short code and explicit auth-test scope; a Lio MESSAGE capture slot is not an auth-test permit.
Actual client build/full source/artifact and actual API source/image/configuration are recorded independently. No selected valid short code or token is committed or printed.
input_zh: 在中文普通登录页，从获准私密清单分别选取两个格式族的合成短码，逐个准确输入。
观察自动大写、智能标点、前后空格和全角数字是否改动输入；用格式不合的合成变体检查本地提示，不泄露有效短码。
用准确格式完成获准换签并进入普通Home；不要发送Lio消息。
input_en: On the ordinary English sign-in screen, enter one approved private synthetic code from each format family exactly.
Check capitalization, punctuation, surrounding whitespace and full-width digits; inspect the local format message for synthetic invalid variants without exposing a valid code.
Use the valid exact format for the approved sign-in and reach ordinary Home; do not send a Lio message.
cases.expected_zh: 输入不被悄悄改写；格式不合时说明正确格式，而非笼统登录失败。准确有效格式的原生换签、实际合成主体与普通Home一致；格式合规不等于认证成功。
cases.expected_en: Preserve the entered bytes and explain invalid format clearly. A valid exact code must have a real native exchange, the intended synthetic subject and ordinary Home; merely passing format validation is insufficient.
cases.judgement: A compares actual input/UI with the approved private value; B binds original auth request/status and resulting synthetic identity. UI success without actual exchange/identity is UNKNOWN. Any proven byte change, invalid acceptance, wrong identity or unusable Home is FAIL. Missing original metadata remains UNKNOWN.
evidence: client build/source/artifact and actual server source/image
no Lio MESSAGE/provider operation; actual fee evidence if any operation unexpectedly occurs

cases.title: 说明页长滚动后完成按钮可点击并可重开
cases.historical_observation: A reproduced the existing done.isHittable failure on an unchanged-input baseline and the input-fix candidate. This is a confirmed local UI failure, not proof of the exact JT build45 first failure or a newly deployed fix.
preconditions: Use A's authorized isolated installation and the actual candidate build/source/artifact; preserve baseline red logs and xcresult privately.
Use the currently authorized display settings. A-owned extra display/accessibility checks remain distinct from C's fixed 14-check smoke.
Do not change consent copy/flow or the JT-only #225 decision to make the test pass.
input_zh: 打开内部说明页，连续滚动本版及上一版说明。
点击完成关闭，再从原入口打开一次并关闭。
input_en: Open the internal information page and scroll through the current and previous release notes.
Tap Done, then reopen through the original entry and close it again.
cases.expected_zh: 完成按钮始终在屏幕内、可点击、点击区域高度至少44点；能关闭并重开，原说明及同意流程不变，不遮挡主流程。
cases.expected_en: Done remains on screen, hittable, and at least 44 points high; it closes the page and works again after reopening. Preserve the original information and consent flow.
cases.judgement: A retains LioBuildUpdatesUITests' actual done.isHittable assertion and close/reopen evidence separately per language; do not replace the click with a bypass or remove/skip the assertion. A recorded missing/off-screen/unhittable control or failed dismissal is FAIL; missing device/artifact/capture is UNKNOWN.
